## FAQs

## What is Nasal Wash? Frequently Asked Questions

What is the advantage of saline nasal wash?

A fair amount of nasal mucus production is normal in the nose. Allergies and infections will lead to
too much mucus production. This will result in nasal symptoms such as runny nose and nasal
congestion. By nasal wash you can remove allergy-causing pollen, dust particles from nasal mucosa
and thus can reduce the inflammation of the mucus membranes. Normal mucosa is more resistant to
infection and allergy symptoms subside.

Nasal wash can be done at any time of the day. However, if applied at night, solution might drip
from the nostrils so applying one or two hours before bedtime is recommended. The same situation is
true before 1-2 hours leaving the house

What is a good time for saline nasal wash?

## FAQs

## What is Nasal Wash? Frequently Asked Questions

What is the advantage of saline nasal wash?

A fair amount of nasal mucus production is normal in the nose. Allergies and infections will lead to
too much mucus production. This will result in nasal symptoms such as runny nose and nasal
congestion. By nasal wash you can remove allergy-causing pollen, dust particles from nasal mucosa
and thus can reduce the inflammation of the mucus membranes. Normal mucosa is more resistant to
infection and allergy symptoms subside.

Nasal wash can be done at any time of the day. However, if applied at night, solution might drip
from the nostrils so applying one or two hours before bedtime is recommended. The same situation is
true before 1-2 hours leaving the house

# The online guide to fresh breath

       We are dedicated to providing you with quality information on how to get rid of bad breath
with proper oral health care procedures and effective products. You will find excellent information
here that will make your breath fresh and stay fresh longer than you thought possible. We invite you
to read our articles to find the best oral care products and procedures. To get started read our
main articles on [What Causes Bad Breath][7] and [How To Get Rid of Bad Breath][8].

## [Oral Care Articles][9]

Read articles on what causes bad breath and what you need to do to make sure you have fresh breath.
Topics range from how to get rid of morning breath to what ingredients to look for or avoid in
buying toothpaste.

## [Oral Health News][10]

The latest science and news on bad breath, oral hygiene, and dental health. We add fresh posts as
new research comes out, so you can keep up with what's actually new in oral care.

find a specific section or page.

### Advanced ENT & Allergy

At Advanced ENT & Allergy, ENT specialists Timothy Queen, MD, Erica Cherry, FNP-BC, and the team
provide complete ear, nose, throat, and allergy care to individuals and families living in and
around Newport News, Virginia, and throughout the Hampton Roads metropolitan area.

The team at Advanced ENT & Allergy provides integrative, compassionate care. The offices are warm
and welcoming, and the facilities are state-of-the-art. Each exam room features cutting-edge
diagnostic equipment, allowing for accurate diagnosis and treatment.

Advanced ENT & Allergy combines ear, nose, throat, and allergy care under one roof. Individuals can
access various services, including in-office surgical procedures, allergy testing, and audiology
screening. The team provides pediatric and adult ENT and allergy care.

tonsil and adenoid surgery, ear surgery, and other specialized procedures. Advanced ENT & Allergy
offers same-day appointments for symptoms that require an immediate diagnosis.

and other in-office procedures. In addition, they regularly administer allergy testing, allergy
shots, allergy drops, food testing, and patch testing, through their sophisticated allergy
laboratory and mixing department.

Take the first step toward improved respiratory health and partner with the Advanced ENT & Allergy
team. Call the office or click the online booking feature to make an appointment.

[Dysphagia][35] means that you cannot swallow well. If you have concerns about your ability to
swallow, [take this 10-question quiz][36]. Summer is also when many families want to get outside and
enjoy the warm weather but make sure to [protect your loved ones against skin cancer][37]. And find
out what you should know about [congenital cytomegalovirus (cCMV)][38].

[**Visit Be ENT Smart for more health tips.**][39]

## A Leading International Pharmaceutical Company located in Greece

The story of the Gerolymatos International **Pharma** began almost 100 years ago in 1923, when
pharmacist, Nikos Gerolymatos, opened his own pharmacy in the heart of Athens. The pharmacy became
one of the largest in the country and the small family business grew. Guided by the dedication of
its founder, the entrepreneurial spirit of his son, Panagiotis, and now his grandson, Nicholas,
Gerolymatos International, is today, one of the most historical, traditional and well-regarded
family businesses in the Greek healthcare industry.

Based in Athens, Greece, with affiliated companies in France, Italy and Cyprus, Gerolymatos
International has a significant **global presence in over 50 countries **worldwide through exclusive
distribution partnerships for its own brand portfolio, namely, **Sinomarin®** (natural nasal & ear
care sea water sprays & vials -medical devices) & **Tamarine®** (pharmaceutical natural laxative in
marmalade form).

With a fully-owned pumping and processing installation for sea water in the northern French Britany
coast –the cleanest, most pristine waters- and a dedicated manufacturing facility in Athens, Greece,
Gerolymatos International produces its Sinomarin product lines for 40 international markets. The
company also provides **contract manufacturing** for hypertonic and isotonic **seawater-based nasal
sprays** and has become a leading **sea water nasal spray manufacturer**, delivering highest quality
products on private label.

Gerolymatos International is committed to pharmaceutical manufacturing, research & development,
marketing, distribution and sales of its own of its own product lines as well as the exclusive
distribution of products from highly esteemed international partners.

With an enduring presence in the Greek domestic market, the company operates in three distinct
segments:
* **OTC division**: caters to the Pharmacy and Supermarket channels, marketing the Company’s own
  brands, and exclusively distributes a wide range of imported OTC products such as **Biofreeze**
  external pain relief portfolio and **Hipp** **organic baby milks and foods**,
* **Optics division**: exclusively distributes the **Alcon Vision Care** product portfolio including
  contact lenses, solutions and eye drops,
* **Vet division**: exclusively distributes the veterinary pharmaceutical product portfolio of
  **Boehringer Ingelheim** and **Affinity Petcare’s** clinical nutrition portfolio.

The company’s extended business network in Greece and abroad includes Pharmaceutical companies and
healthcare professionals such as medical doctors, veterinarians, opticians and pharmacists, amongst
other specialties.

Balloon Sinuplasty Conditions

## Who can benefit from balloon sinuplasty?

Balloon sinuplasty is a pain-free procedure that provides lasting relief for those suffering from
several chronic sinus issues. Balloon sinuplasty is simple and performed 100% in-office by Dr.
Michael Kaplan, who inserts and inflates a small balloon in your affected sinuses in order to
restore proper shape and airflow. Best of all, balloon sinuplasty is typically covered by most
insurance providers and Medicare.

Sinus snoring

[Chevron down]

### A snoring solution that works

Snoring is closely related to sinus health. Balloon sinuplasty stops snoring in its tracks by
opening blocked sinus cavities, allowing you to breathe easier through your nose during sleep.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Snoring][20]
[Woman laughing][Man smiling]

Frequent infections

[Chevron down]

### Finally, real freedom from chronic sinusitis

Chronic sinusitis balloon sinuplasty targets the source of chronic sinus infections by opening
blocked sinus cavities, providing you with long-term freedom from symptoms and future infections.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Chronic Sinusitis][21]
[Man cycling][Smiling woman]

Sinus headaches

[Chevron down]

### Eliminate chronic sinus headaches at the source

Balloon sinuplasty improves your sinus cavities’ ability to drain built-up mucus, reducing pressure
and relieving painful sinus headache symptoms.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Sinus Headaches][22]
[Woman waking up][Child smiling]

Chronic cough

[Chevron down]

### Put an end to your chronic cough

Wondering how to get rid of your chronic cough? Balloon sinuplasty opens your sinus cavities so that
excess post nasal drip can drain properly and you can finally find relief from your chronic cough.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Chronic Cough][23]
[Woman smiling][Smiling couple]

Chronic allergies

[Chevron down]

### Target your chronic allergy symptoms

Balloon sinuplasty opens your sinus passageways, preventing allergy-related infections, restoring
proper drainage, and allowing you to breathe freely again.

[
[Arrow right thin]

[Family smiling][Couple laughing]

Dr Stephen Kleid

Dr Stephen Kleid MBBS FRACS is a highly experienced Ear, Nose and Throat ENT Surgeon
(Otolaryngologist) based in Melbourne, with a passion for Nose Surgery – Septo-Rhinoplasty,
Septoplasty and a strong interest in Rhinoplasty Revision. He also performs a wide range of ENT
surgery problems such as Tonsils, Adenoids and Grommets.

Dr Kleid has performed over 10,000 nose and sinus operations including 2000 rhinoplasties in over 35
years of Surgery. He is one of Australia's most experienced Head and Neck Surgeons and teaches his
innovative surgical techniques.

# Melbourne ENT Surgeons

Melbourne ENT is the ENT practice of Dr Stephen Kleid and Dr Simon Braham. Both FRACS surgeons
deliver thorough, clear, and compassionate care tailored to each patient.

**Dr Stephen Kleid **has over 35 years’ surgical experience in nose surgery and common ENT problems
like snoring and sleep apnoea. He also has senior roles at Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre for head
and neck tumours.

**Dr Simon Braham**, trained in New York and Boston, performs surgery for nasal and sinus
conditions.

**Dr Stephen Kleid - AHPRA MED0001052799**
**Dr Simon Braham - AHPRA MED0001144757**

Dr Stephen Kleid

Dr Stephen Kleid MBBS FRACS is a highly experienced Ear, Nose and Throat ENT Surgeon
(Otolaryngologist) based in Melbourne, with a passion for Nose Surgery – Septo-Rhinoplasty,
Septoplasty and a strong interest in Rhinoplasty Revision. He also performs a wide range of ENT
surgery problems such as Tonsils, Adenoids and Grommets.

Dr Kleid has performed over 10,000 nose and sinus operations including 2000 rhinoplasties in over 35
years of Surgery. He is one of Australia's most experienced Head and Neck Surgeons and teaches his
innovative surgical techniques.

**AHPRA** (Medical Board) Registration number – MED0001052799
**MBBS FRACS** (Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons)
**AAFPS** - Member of the Australasian Academy of Facial Plastic Surgery
**AAFPRS** – (International Member of the American Academy of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive
Surgeons)

Dr Simon Braham

Dr Simon Braham MBBS (Hons) FRACS is an experienced Ear, Nose and Throat ENT Surgeon
(Otolaryngologist) based in Melbourne, performing nose surgery, tonsil, grommet and sinus surgery
for children & adults.

Dr Braham consults with patients having breathing issues, snoring concerns and sleep disturbances.

**Dr Simon Braham - AHPRA MED0001144757**

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

[injection_icon (4)]

Easy to use. No nasal swabs or needles

[shield_icon (2)]

Safe to use, even if opioids are not present

[prescription_icon]

Original prescription strength

[clock_icon]

Works quickly, often reversing an opioid overdose in minutes

[ambulance_icon]

Same brand used by first responders

[Hand Spraying Narcan Nasal Spray]

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.
Lay Spray Stay

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

[injection_icon (4)]

Easy to use. No nasal swabs or needles

[shield_icon (2)]

Safe to use, even if opioids are not present

[prescription_icon]

Original prescription strength

[clock_icon]

Works quickly, often reversing an opioid overdose in minutes

[ambulance_icon]

Same brand used by first responders

[Hand Spraying Narcan Nasal Spray]

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.

## FAQ's

## I have shopped at NeilMed.com before but can’t login to my account.

If you created an account or placed an order on NeilMed.com prior to October 5, 2021 you will need
to re-register again. We apologize for the inconvenience. We have updated our website and system and
for security purposes a new password is required.

## I forgot my password. How can I update it?

Go to Your Account, click "Sign in with your NeilMed Account". Under Personal Information, click
"Forgot your Password?". Enter your email address and continue to follow the instructions on the
screen. At the end of the process, you will receive an email with a link to reset your password. If
you are still having trouble, please contact our Customer Service at [1 877 477 8633][35] or email
[questions@neilmed.com][36] and we will help you update your password.

## Where can I find a retailer in my area that sells NeilMed products?

NeilMed products are available nationwide at all leading drug and food stores. Please visit our
[Store Locator][37] to find the local stores near you.

## Are your entire products on your website?

Yes, everything NeilMed currently has available is available for purchase on our website. If there
is something you cannot find, please contact our Customer Service toll free at [1 877 477 8633][38]
or email [questions@neilmed.com][39].

## Promotion Codes

NeilMed promotion codes can be redeemed in the Promotion Code section on the final page in the
checkout process, on the "Review & Place Order" screen. The promotion code reduces your cart
subtotal only and does not apply toward Shipping & Handling. A promotion code cannot be applied to
previous purchases and are only valid for use one time per customer. You can receive notice of our
special promotions by registering your email address on our email sign up form located in the footer
of our website.

## Payment Options

NeilMed.com accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and
Amazon Pay. We also accept Debit cards with a Visa or MasterCard logo.

## Telephone Orders

For the most efficient service we suggest you place your order online. If you prefer placing your
order by phone, please call [1 877 477 8633][40].

## Can I save the items in my cart?

account, place items in your cart, review your cart and then select "Save for Later". The next time

## Our Story

From a medical idea to a global movement in nasal care.

NeilMed Pharmaceuticals was founded by Dr. Mehta and his wife Nina in Santa Rosa, California, with a
mission to make safe and effective nasal and sinus care accessible to everyone.

What started as a simple physician’s idea has become a globally trusted brand, recommended by ENT
specialists and healthcare professionals in over 70 countries for over two decades.

## Our Core Values

Dedicated to health, innovation, and safety you can trust.

### Clinically Proven Care

All NeilMed products are designed with medical expertise and backed by scientific research to ensure
comfort and effectiveness.

### Safe & Sterile

We maintain the highest manufacturing standards, ensuring every product is free from preservatives,
BPA, and latex.

### Global Wellness

With millions of users worldwide, NeilMed continues to promote better breathing and wellness across
all ages and lifestyles.

## Our Journey

From California to the world.

2000

#### The Beginning

Dr. Mehta created the first NeilMed Sinus Rinse bottle system after witnessing patients’ struggles
with chronic sinus issues.

2010

#### Global Trust

NeilMed became one of the most recommended brands for nasal irrigation worldwide, distributed across
hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics.

2025

#### Innovation for Every Breath

NeilMed continues to expand its product range, integrating user-focused technology and sustainable
packaging for future generations.

## Classic Collections

### NeilMed Sinus Rinse™

The best-selling nasal irrigation system trusted by doctors worldwide. It provides natural relief
for congestion, allergies, and sinus symptoms with gentle saline rinsing.

### NeilMed NasaFlo® Neti Pot

Inspired by Ayurveda, this portable ceramic-style system delivers a smooth, soothing rinse
experience to flush out mucus and allergens naturally.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common concerns about sinus health and NeilMed products.

01

### Are NeilMed products safe for everyday use?

Yes. NeilMed products are formulated for gentle daily use and are recommended by physicians
worldwide for safe nasal hygiene.

02

### How do I prepare the saline solution?

Use NeilMed pre-mixed packets with previously boiled or distilled water. Always follow the
instructions included in each box for proper hygiene.

03

### Can children use NeilMed Sinus Rinse?

Children aged 4 and above can use NeilMed products under adult supervision. Pediatric versions are
available for more comfortable use.

04

### What if I experience discomfort during use?

Ensure the solution is the correct concentration and at body temperature. If irritation persists,
consult your healthcare provider before continuing use.

## Our Story

From a medical idea to a global movement in nasal care.

NeilMed Pharmaceuticals was founded by Dr. Mehta and his wife Nina in Santa Rosa, California, with a
mission to make safe and effective nasal and sinus care accessible to everyone.

What started as a simple physician’s idea has become a globally trusted brand, recommended by ENT
specialists and healthcare professionals in over 70 countries for over two decades.

## Our Core Values

Dedicated to health, innovation, and safety you can trust.

### Clinically Proven Care

All NeilMed products are designed with medical expertise and backed by scientific research to ensure
comfort and effectiveness.

### Safe & Sterile

We maintain the highest manufacturing standards, ensuring every product is free from preservatives,
BPA, and latex.

### Global Wellness

With millions of users worldwide, NeilMed continues to promote better breathing and wellness across
all ages and lifestyles.

## Our Journey

From California to the world.

2000

#### The Beginning

Dr. Mehta created the first NeilMed Sinus Rinse bottle system after witnessing patients’ struggles
with chronic sinus issues.

2010

#### Global Trust

NeilMed became one of the most recommended brands for nasal irrigation worldwide, distributed across
hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics.

2025

#### Innovation for Every Breath

NeilMed continues to expand its product range, integrating user-focused technology and sustainable
packaging for future generations.

## Classic Collections

### NeilMed Sinus Rinse™

The best-selling nasal irrigation system trusted by doctors worldwide. It provides natural relief
for congestion, allergies, and sinus symptoms with gentle saline rinsing.

### NeilMed NasaFlo® Neti Pot

Inspired by Ayurveda, this portable ceramic-style system delivers a smooth, soothing rinse
experience to flush out mucus and allergens naturally.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common concerns about sinus health and NeilMed products.

01

### Are NeilMed products safe for everyday use?

Yes. NeilMed products are formulated for gentle daily use and are recommended by physicians
worldwide for safe nasal hygiene.

02

### How do I prepare the saline solution?

Use NeilMed pre-mixed packets with previously boiled or distilled water. Always follow the
instructions included in each box for proper hygiene.

03

### Can children use NeilMed Sinus Rinse?

Children aged 4 and above can use NeilMed products under adult supervision. Pediatric versions are
available for more comfortable use.

04

### What if I experience discomfort during use?

Ensure the solution is the correct concentration and at body temperature. If irritation persists,
consult your healthcare provider before continuing use.

  products (preserved and sterile/non-preserved), the capabilities offered by our skilled in-house

  Equipped with a state-of-the-art laboratory, we have the capabilities to conduct a wide range of
  nasal spray testing services across unit-dose, bi-dose and multi-dose devices, covering everything
  from particle-size distribution to plume geometry. The combination of detailed spray
  characterisation and decades of experience enable us to enhance and accelerate product

* Convenient, needle-free drug delivery
* Local and systemic acting
* Rapid onset

## Aseptic Filling

In the manufacturing of nasal spray and ophthalmic drug products, quality and safety are paramount.
Pharma companies must be able to rely on a trusted partner with the knowledge and capabilities to
deliver service excellence in compliance with the latest regulatory standards.
At LTS, we have the capacity, expertise and experience to support a full spectrum of aseptic
processing and sterilization services for products including small molecules, biologics, controlled
substances (DEA Schedule I-V).
Our modern filling operations integrate advanced contamination control strategies and highly
automated systems for inspection and packaging, ensuring consistent quality, efficiency, and
reliable product release. Each year, multiple inspections by customers and international regulatory
agencies confirm our adherence to the highest standards – reinforcing our proven track record in
sterile drug delivery.

### Features of filling lines
* Aseptic nasal spray filler
* High-speed filling
* Small-batch filling: Clinical trial and development batches

# Breathing innovation into nasal drug delivery

The nose offers great potential as a patient-friendly pathway for local and systemic drug delivery.
Our expertise and technical capabilities in the development and manufacturing of nasal drug products
are designed to ensure that potential is realised for pharma partners.

## Key services for pharmaceutical partners
* **Nasal spray manufacturing capabilities**
  
  Our broad expertise in nasal drug delivery spans the entire product development cycle from
  formulation science to scale-up manufacture. Whether working with unit-dose, bi-dose or multi-dose
  products (preserved and sterile/non-preserved), the capabilities offered by our skilled in-house
  scientists and engineers ensures we can support any nasal project at any stage.
* **Nasal spray testing**
  
  Equipped with a state-of-the-art laboratory, we have the capabilities to conduct a wide range of
  nasal spray testing services across unit-dose, bi-dose and multi-dose devices, covering everything
  from particle-size distribution to plume geometry. The combination of detailed spray
  characterisation and decades of experience enable us to enhance and accelerate product
  development.
* **Nasal spray development**
  
  We are a specialist CDMO for nasal drug products, and our experience in the sector runs deep
  throughout the organisation. That means our partners can lean on our authoritative knowledge to
  guide and advance projects at any stage, from initial concept and testing through to device
  selection and commercialisation.
* **Site transfer**
  
  Balancing rigorous structure with the ability to flex manufacturing capacity, we can support the
  seamless transfer of intranasal products currently in commercial production. The process is
  closely monitored and managed by our experienced project managers, who are assigned to ensure
  project deadlines are met and transition to the facility is completed smoothly.
* **Aseptic filling**
  
  Our expertise in aseptic filling perfectly complements our device development services. Supported
  by advanced contamination control strategies and enhanced by automated inspection systems, our
  filling operations meet the highest regulatory requirements. We are equipped to handle a broad
  spectrum of sterile manufacturing needs, including small molecules, biologics, potent compounds
  and controlled substances (DEA Schedule I–V).
* **Packaging**
  
  Our flexible, customisable secondary packaging solutions ensure the finishing touch is applied at
  the end of the manufacturing process. Packaging options are tailored to each particular nasal drug
  product, whether in the form of blister packaging for micro-dose devices or automated cartoning.
  We ensure the end result delivers on all requirements, from data serialisation and product
  security to brand promotion.

### Key benefits for patients
* Convenient, needle-free drug delivery
* Local and systemic acting
* Rapid onset
* Improved bioavailability
* Bypasses problems with oral delivery

## Aseptic Filling

In the manufacturing of nasal spray and ophthalmic drug products, quality and safety are paramount.
Pharma companies must be able to rely on a trusted partner with the knowledge and capabilities to
deliver service excellence in compliance with the latest regulatory standards.
At LTS, we have the capacity, expertise and experience to support a full spectrum of aseptic
processing and sterilization services for products including small molecules, biologics, controlled
substances (DEA Schedule I-V).
Our modern filling operations integrate advanced contamination control strategies and highly
automated systems for inspection and packaging, ensuring consistent quality, efficiency, and
reliable product release. Each year, multiple inspections by customers and international regulatory
agencies confirm our adherence to the highest standards – reinforcing our proven track record in
sterile drug delivery.

### Features of filling lines
* Aseptic nasal spray filler
* High-speed filling
* Small-batch filling: Clinical trial and development batches

## FAQ's

## I have shopped at NeilMed.com before but can’t login to my account.

If you created an account or placed an order on NeilMed.com prior to October 5, 2021 you will need
to re-register again. We apologize for the inconvenience. We have updated our website and system and
for security purposes a new password is required.

## I forgot my password. How can I update it?

Go to Your Account, click "Sign in with your NeilMed Account". Under Personal Information, click
"Forgot your Password?". Enter your email address and continue to follow the instructions on the
screen. At the end of the process, you will receive an email with a link to reset your password. If
you are still having trouble, please contact our Customer Service at [1 877 477 8633][41] or email
[questions@neilmed.com][42] and we will help you update your password.

## Where can I find a retailer in my area that sells NeilMed products?

NeilMed products are available nationwide at all leading drug and food stores. Please visit our
[Store Locator][43] to find the local stores near you.

## Are your entire products on your website?

Yes, everything NeilMed currently has available is available for purchase on our website. If there
is something you cannot find, please contact our Customer Service toll free at [1 877 477 8633][44]
or email [questions@neilmed.com][45].

## Promotion Codes

NeilMed promotion codes can be redeemed in the Promotion Code section on the final page in the
checkout process, on the "Review & Place Order" screen. The promotion code reduces your cart
subtotal only and does not apply toward Shipping & Handling. A promotion code cannot be applied to
previous purchases and are only valid for use one time per customer. You can receive notice of our
special promotions by registering your email address on our email sign up form located in the footer
of our website.

## Payment Options

NeilMed.com accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and
Amazon Pay. We also accept Debit cards with a Visa or MasterCard logo.

## Telephone Orders

For the most efficient service we suggest you place your order online. If you prefer placing your
order by phone, please call [1 877 477 8633][46].

## Can I save the items in my cart?

By creating an account you can save items to your personal shopping cart indefinitely. Login to your
account, place items in your cart, review your cart and then select "Save for Later". The next time
you return to NeilMed.com, login to your account and proceed to the shopping cart to review saved
items.

Center][54], Garberville [Pharmacy][55], and Fortuna [Optometry][56]. We offer laboratory,

ethical application of state of the art treatment. The Tarabichi Brothers epitomize integrity and

At Tarabichi ENT, we pride ourselves on our team of highly experienced and renowned doctors, each a
leader in their respective sub-specialty within the field of ENT. Our doctors are carefully selected
